test: R2 nuisance-seed robustness vs sector+120D-location matched random controls
interpretation: one-sided permutation-style percentile: higher is better; 95 corresponds to p<=0.05 under the matched-control reference distribution
fail_rule: Anything else retires R2 as a stock-selection rule, including cases where a non-primary cap clears 95 while N=20 does not.
what_a_pass_allows: Proceed to a genuinely clean out-of-sample protocol with rule discovery confined to pre-2023 data and one-time evaluation on 2023-present.
what_a_pass_does_not_allow: Deployment or claims of validated alpha. The current window overlaps the rule-mining period, uses today's universe historically, and samples weekly rather than the live daily cadence.
notes: Primary statistic and thresholds are fixed before reading the seed-robustness result.
The matched control must preserve signal date, sector, 120-day-high location bucket, liquidity floor, holding period, and transaction-cost assumptions.
No threshold changes are permitted after result inspection.
